title: NY Attorney General looks into city of Oswego’s role in Border Patrol standoff
summary: New York State Attorney General's Office is investigating the City of Oswego's involvement in a Border Patrol standoff that occurred last month, during which two individuals sought refuge on a residential roof for nearly six hours. The investigation centers on the city's role and response to the incident.
